issue.title: gkeep_auth login_missing_email_is_a_setup_error panics with broken pipe writing stdin
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-2k.4 (Help and docs for =x<N>!<M>), triaged by bob-cli-2k.land.

`tests/gkeep_auth.rs::login_missing_email_is_a_setup_error` failed once during a full `cargo test` run with a broken-pipe panic. It passed on retry, both with and without the phase's docs-only changes. It passed in the bob-cli-2k.land full run on master b3405bd (gkeep_auth: 11 passed).

Likely root cause (from reading the code): `run_login` (tests/gkeep_auth.rs:99-122) spawns `bob gkeep login` with piped stdin, then calls `child.stdin.take().write_all(stdin_text).expect("write stdin")`. In this test `gkeep.email` is not configured, so login exits 2 with a setup error without ever reading stdin. When the child exits and closes its stdin before the test writes, `write_all` returns EPIPE and `expect("write stdin")` panics. This is a timing race.

Fix: make `run_login` tolerate `ErrorKind::BrokenPipe` on the stdin write (ignore it, then assert on the exit status and stderr as today), or write stdin from a helper thread and ignore the write result. Keep asserting exit code 2, the `gkeep.email` hint, and `fake.call_count() == 0`. Check the other stdin-writing helpers in tests/gkeep_*.rs for the same pattern.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 failure (broken pipe panic at the stdin write) in one full cargo test run by bob-cli-2k.4; passed on retry with and without its docs-only changes. It passed again in the bob-cli-2k.land full run on master b3405bd. The failure is timing-dependent: the child exits on the missing gkeep.email setup error before the test writes stdin. Serial reproduction has not been attempted.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-2k.4 hit an intermittent broken-pipe panic in this test during a full cargo test run; the test helper writes stdin to a login process that can exit before reading it.
